children: unveiled a virtual reality headset designed in a glasses form factor, combining 3D entertainment, immersive sports and a virtual workspace, with the device set to go on sale in spring 2027 for $1,299.99.

The Meta VR Glasses weigh about 100 grams, according to the company, and use a two-part design that separates the glasses from a connected puck containing computing components, a battery, and storage.

said the glasses feature micro-OLED displays, 5K resolution, and Dolby Vision, along with spatial audio. The device will also include Meta's artificial intelligence assistant and support hand gestures and eye movements for navigation without controllers.
The company said the glasses will be the first VR device certified as IMAX Enhanced and will support 3D movies through services including Disney+. Meta
said thousands of titles will be available internationally by launch, with additional 3D releases planned.
The glasses will also offer immersive live sports, with Meta
saying users will have access to more than 100 such events annually through partners including MLB, NBC Sports, TNT Sports, and UFC.
For work, users can create multiple virtual screens and turn a flat surface into a keyboard and touchpad, Meta
The company also announced hologram-based video calling for apps including WhatsApp and Zoom.

title: Meta unveils $1,300 VR glasses with 3D movies and immersive sports
